shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن أبي بكر بن أبي قحافة

notes: Taḥwīl: the first branch ends at «عن مخرمة», which is the same man as the tail's «مخرمة بن بكير» (rule 7), so the fuller name stands once, in the tail
«ابن» in «ابن وهب» and «عبد الله بن وهب» of the first branch are two surfaces as written
«مولى ابن عمر» is an epithet of Nafi' and is left out; Aisha is the last link
